catalog_source.integration: independent fixed-rule rebuild; repository code is not executed or copied

heikin_ashi.close: mean of adjusted open high low close
heikin_ashi.recursive_open: mean of previous Heikin-Ashi open and close
heikin_ashi.high: maximum of adjusted high, Heikin-Ashi open and close
heikin_ashi.low: minimum of adjusted low, Heikin-Ashi open and close

fixed_candidates.source_exact: enter one unit after two bearish HA candles when current has no upper wick and its body is larger; exit all after two bullish HA candles when current has no lower wick
fixed_candidates.direction_corrected: enter one unit after two bullish HA candles when current has no lower wick and its body is larger; exit all after two bearish HA candles when current has no upper wick

negative_controls: one additional trading-day stale state for each candidate
five additional trading-day stale state for each candidate
deterministic within-date permutation preserving the candidate's complete unit distribution

portfolio.turnover: half L1 change including cash from drifted holdings

promotion_gates.primary_performance: annual return positive, Sharpe above 0.5, and maximum drawdown no worse than -25 percent at 50 bps
promotion_gates.stress: annual return and both later windows positive at 100 bps
promotion_gates.controls: candidate Sharpe exceeds its stale and matched-random controls at 50 bps
promotion_gates.dependence: absolute correlation no greater than 0.80 to frozen trend and core
promotion_gates.blend: 80/20 core-candidate blend improves Sharpe with no worse drawdown and familywise paired Sharpe lower bound above zero
